hooks.command: if [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/xtask/hooks/hook.sh" ]; then sh "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/xtask/hooks/hook.sh" pre-tool-use; else echo "xtask hook: $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR has no xtask/hooks/hook.sh; the git guard is off" >&2; fi

if [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/xtask/hooks/hook.sh" ]; then sh "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/xtask/hooks/hook.sh" post-tool-use; else echo "xtask hook: $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR has no xtask/hooks/hook.sh; no checkpoint is kept" >&2; fi

if [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/xtask/hooks/hook.sh" ]; then sh "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/xtask/hooks/hook.sh" stop; else echo "xtask hook: $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR has no xtask/hooks/hook.sh; no checks run" >&2; fi

if [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/xtask/hooks/hook.sh" ]; then sh "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/xtask/hooks/hook.sh" stop; else echo "xtask hook: $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR has no xtask/hooks/hook.sh; no checks run" >&2; fi
